# Compare versions

Choose two versions to see how the statement has changed. Sections are matched by heading, so changes in order do not hide edits to the wording.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from scripts.mission_site import load_versions, comparison_page

# All comparisons are calculated here with Python's standard library.
# The rendered HTML contains the data and works without a server or an API.
print(comparison_page(load_versions()))
```
